purpose: Resolve reconstruction inputs by source authority without collapsing evidence classes.

precedence.rule: Direct current measurement or mechanically/metric registered geometry governs current as-built dimensions when provenance and residuals are valid.
Direct current photos/video/visible part observation governs visible topology and state; perspective images alone do not create metric truth.

Direct technical statements from people materially involved with this wheel have priority over external analogies and unsupported reconstruction assumptions for function, terminology, assembly logic and intended construction.

Local historical drawings govern documented historical design, but are not silently promoted to current as-built geometry. Explicit, source-scoped current_drawing_confirmations override the historical-only applicability for the named drawings; legibility and reference-edge interpretation remain separate checks.
Unregistered local scan supports form/visibility comparison but not mechanical location or metric truth.
Comparable water-wheel construction expands candidate space only and cannot override local evidence.
Brute-force or engineering candidates remain hypotheses until promoted by stronger evidence.

ThorstenHalsch.caveat: Expert authority outranks analogy and unsupported model assumptions, but does not replace direct current measurement for metric geometry.

promotion_rule: Synthetic geometry may enter the Truth Model only when supported by current observation/measurement or by explicit expert construction knowledge for the claimed non-metric property. Metric values still require metric evidence. Explicitly confirmed current component drawings supply metric evidence for their readable dimensions within the documented scope; ambiguous references and global pose remain unresolved.

current_drawing_confirmations.confirmation: Diese Zeichnungen entsprechen exakt der heutigen Rinne und des heutigen Schöpftrogs.
current_drawing_confirmations.scope: Lesbare Maße und dargestellte Form des heutigen Schöpftrogs sowie des auf IMG_6830 ausdrücklich als Rinne 1 bezeichneten Bauteils.
current_drawing_confirmations.rule: For these sources, use readable drawing dimensions and depicted component form as the current construction reference ahead of perspective-based estimates and synthetic model geometry. Preserve each dimension line's reference edges; photograph legibility limits do not invalidate confirmed current applicability.
limits: Two trough images show the same sheet, not independent designs.
Does not confirm a surveyed global installation angle, scan registration or terrain profile.
Does not assign the 415/422/480 lines to two separate channel parts or infer concealed overlap dimensions.
Does not promote other historical drawings or generic stock recommendations.
